rationale: Pulp's shared Skia Graphite surface disables Graphite's optional internal 4x MSAA and uses single-sample internal targets. Intel macOS Metal rejects the Dawn-generated MSAA pipeline in hosted plugin surfaces, producing a black editor; Pulp's own analytic antialiasing preserves the visible result while avoiding that driver path. This is a Pulp-owned platform compatibility fix with no API, authority, design-import, or Vellum framework boundary move.
tests: native Intel Spectr VST3/CLAP REAPER qualification
